name: Scripted actions executed as intended, per format
purpose: A reply in each format a model of a supported family emits is executed with the effect its author intended, and an unsafe action (a path outside the folder, an ambiguous edit) is refused.
record: The share of fifteen replies, each run through the real reader over a real folder, (evaluation/agent_action_format/build_cases.py) whose effect holds, reported per format: the text protocol, function-call markup (a real defect), a fenced JSON action and native tool calls (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, several calls, an ambiguous edit, a path outside the folder). No model call: the replies are written from real failure shapes.
disadvantages: The replies are written from real failure shapes, not sampled from a model; it measures the reader, not whether the model emits the format; a provider's own agent loop executes its own calls and cannot be scripted, so its share is the paid measure of Delegated Agent Sessions.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=hubofhubs/the_world/tools/agent_action_format/tests/test_agent_action_format.py passes] > paid [real=yes | when=tasks completed per arm on the same model are recorded in metric-delegated-agent-sessions and the format is the only difference between two arms]
command: esoi run agent_action_format --impl text_protocol; esoi run agent_action_format --impl native_tool_calls; esoi run agent_action_format --impl any_format
